overview_description.description: Bevi develops a smart water dispenser that provides customizable flavors made from filtered tap water and natural ingredients. Bevi aims to eliminate waste from the production, shipping, and disposing of bottled beverages. Bevi envisions a future where a smarter platform (powered by the municipal water supply) transforms how beverages are delivered.

about_short_description.short_description: Bevi develops a smart water dispenser that customizes flavored and sparkling beverages on demand.

product.name: The Standup 2.0
product.description: A freestanding, bottleless smart water dispenser that provides filtered still, sparkling, ambient, and hot water with customizable flavors, carbonation, and functional enhancements.

product.name: The Countertop
product.description: A compact, bottleless water dispenser for commercial spaces that provides filtered still, sparkling, ambient, and hot water with customizable flavors and enhancements.

product.name: Flavors & Enhancements
product.description: Natural flavor concentrates and functional beverage additions used with Bevi dispensers to create customized still or sparkling drinks with adjustable flavor strength.

product.name: Bevi Machine Rental
product.description: A temporary dispenser rental service that provides a Bevi machine, delivery, installation, and event support for corporate gatherings and other short-term commercial uses.

product.name: Bevi Installation, Maintenance & Service
product.description: Commercial deployment and support services for Bevi dispensers, including installation, consumable replenishment, filter replacement, monitoring, diagnostics, and ongoing maintenance.
